title: Population-specific transcriptomic shifts underlie secondary metabolic diversification in Aspergillus flavus Link and the domestication of Aspergillus oryzae (Ahlb.).
authors: Drott, Milton T; Wang, Yen-Wen; Hatmaker, E Anne; Mercado-Soto, Nayanna M; Elmore, J Mitch; Luciano-Rosaro, Dianiris; Yu, Jae-Hyuk; Rokas, Antonis; Gibbons, John G; Huttenlocher, Anna; Yang, Kunlong; Keller, Nancy P
one_liner_zh: 该文研究曲霉群体转录组与次级代谢分化，仅用机器学习推断基因调控网络，未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The genomic signatures of microbial domestication remain poorly understood within the context of natural population variation. Here, we demonstrate that Aspergillus oryzae, the filamentous fungus used in soy sauce and sake production, shares more recent ancestry with a predominantly northern, largely non-aflatoxigenic population of Aspergillus flavus (population C). A. oryzae isolates also overlap with the recently described, clinically enriched A. flavus population D, suggesting multiple domestication events. All isolates tested retained pathogenicity in a zebrafish infection model. At the transcriptomic level, populations are significantly differentiated and respond differently to spore density, suggesting population-specific adaptations to ecological conditions. Although most transcriptomic variation was consistent with phylogenetic relationships, several co-expression modules exhibited significantly greater divergence than expected from phylogeny alone, suggesting that phenotypic diversification may sometimes occur through the reorganization of transcriptomic architectures. A. oryzae also displayed elevated expression of a carbohydrate-metabolism module; however, this pattern was consistent with phylogenetic differentiation, suggesting that enhanced carbohydrate metabolism may have begun evolving prior to domestication or may be most apparent under fermentation-relevant conditions. Population-specific variation is also evident among secondary metabolite (SM) gene clusters. While A. oryzae shows markedly reduced expression of aflatoxin biosynthesis genes, this trend does not extend across the entire secondary metabolome. Using machine-learning-based gene regulatory network inference, we identified population-specific transcriptomic differences linked to distinct transcription factors, with evidence for both cis- and trans-acting regulatory divergence, but no changes in global regulators such as laeA. Together, these findings provide new insights into the domestication of A. oryzae, its global significance, and the microevolution of fungal secondary metabolic pathways.
abstract_zh: 微生物驯化的基因组特征在自然群体变异的背景下仍知之甚少。在此，我们证明米曲霉（Aspergillus oryzae），即用于酱油和清酒生产的丝状真菌，与一个主要分布于北方、 largely 非产黄曲霉毒素的黄曲霉（Aspergillus flavus）群体（群体C）共享更近的祖先。米曲霉分离株还与最近描述的、临床上富集的黄曲霉群体D重叠，表明存在多次驯化事件。所有测试的分离株在斑马鱼感染模型中均保留致病性。在转录组水平上，各群体显著分化，并对孢子密度作出不同响应，提示群体特异的生态条件适应性。尽管大多数转录组变异与系统发育关系一致，但若干共表达模块表现出显著高于仅基于系统发育预期的分化程度，表明表型多样化有时可能通过转录组架构的重组发生。米曲霉还表现出碳水化合物代谢模块的高表达；然而，这一模式与系统发育分化一致，提示增强的碳水化合物代谢可能在驯化之前就已开始演化，或仅在发酵相关条件下最为明显。群体特异的变异在次级代谢物（SM）基因簇中也显而易见。虽然米曲霉表现出黄曲霉毒素生物合成基因的显著降低表达，但这一趋势并未延伸至整个次级代谢组。利用基于机器学习的基因调控网络推断，我们识别出与不同转录因子相关的群体特异转录组差异，并存在顺式和反式调控分化的证据，但全局调控因子如laeA无变化。综合这些发现，为米曲霉的驯化、其全球意义以及真菌次级代谢途径的微演化提供了新见解。
